design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER -- task 1 (gap_waiver_cancellations_and_claims, GAP Waiver Plus 150, unrecovered theft), revision 7 (rework round 6)

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems = 1, factor_counts [6, 4]. Assignment: gap_ext_plus_worksheet_benefit 6 (root, owner=user: the borrower accepts the worksheet benefit on his claim), gap_ext_plus_starting_balance 4.

2. Why this is a good test. The borrower asks what the GAP waiver pays on his theft claim so he can accept it. The Plus worksheet benefit starts from the claim's starting balance, which the claim does not yet carry, so the agent first works the Plus starting balance from the contract's signed terms and servicing record (a 47-day first period, a due-date change that moved the schedule 18 days to a due day past the loss day, the SCRA rate cap still in effect at the loss) and records it; the benefit then deducts the Plus excluded total itemized from the contract (two unpaid installments at the loss, fees net of post-loss late charges), its servicing record (two one-installment extensions, the latest under the cap), the tracking record (placement and its refund), the service contract (cancelled for the theft and refunded) and the deductible above the plan's reimbursement maximum, and the insurer's net settlement. The borrower records his acceptance with the handed tool.

3. Scope. Task 0 holds the Premier reimbursement, Premier starting balance, Premier excluded total and worksheet benefit with their tools. Task 1 claims gap_ext_plus_worksheet_benefit (accept_plus_claim_benefit_e7b3150d, owner=user) and gap_ext_plus_starting_balance (record_plus_claim_balance_at_loss_c4d2a91e).

4. Problem-tree card. Root gap_ext_plus_worksheet_benefit; edge value_input, state form: "The Plus worksheet benefit is not worked out until the claim carries a starting balance above 0.00." Opening: balance_at_loss_usd = 0.0. Only the Plus starting-balance rule (its tool, scoped to Plus claims) writes a Plus claim's balance at loss, and it is above 0.00 whenever a claim is reported. The starting balance is the benefit's first term, so every cent of it moves the benefit. Skipped: benefit 0.00 instead of 1,027.96. No prerequisite in the persona; tools validate nothing.

5. Base-invariant card. Subject gap_claim_opened; gap_claim_benefit gates met at filing (2026-10-06, 46 days after the loss) or not applicable; policy_scope. Declared overwrites: the scheduled-balance clause (Plus starting balance, sibling names Premier); the excluded_amounts clause, the service-contract refund clause and the force-placed premium clause, and the actual-cash-value / deductible-covered clause (Plus worksheet benefit, siblings name Premier), each restating the base for other plans. The loan-to-value excess and the Plus uncovered deductible follow the base (gap_msr_excess_ltv_amount; deductible_reimbursement_basis).

6. Business-object card. Target: the one claim record of the Plus addendum (theft_unrecovered, loss 2026-08-21, Peach State Casualty Company, ACV 12,400.00, deductible 750.00, the policy's comprehensive deductible, above the 500.00 plan maximum); figures from the Tier 3 contract, its tracking record and its DriveSure Gold service contract.

7. World (from origination; every contract row priced by the contract product's published terms). Georgia contract signed 2023-11-24 (first payment 2024-01-10, 47-day first period, 60 months, 21,750.00 at 19.99 percent, installment 576.12; payments by ACH self-service); due-date change 2024-06-03 (5 installments paid, current, due day 10 -> 28, next due 2024-06-10 -> 2024-06-28, 18 days, within Tier 3's 20); CPI lapse (proof expired 2024-05-24), notices 2024-05-28 / 2024-06-12, placement 2024-06-27 (premiums 129.95 and 131.75, both billed 2024-06-27; the latest premium is the one whose billing period starts latest), proof 2024-07-07 (Peach State Casualty, coverage from 2024-07-05), refund 96.62 credited 2024-07-14, renewals reviewed 2025-06-20 and 2026-06-18 (comprehensive 750.00, collision 1,000.00, within Plan D's 1,000.00); extension 2025-03-03 (13 installments paid, seasoning allowance one installment, Georgia charge 20.00, no handling or review charge, no late charge to credit); SCRA cap from the duty start 2025-11-03 (request signed 2025-11-12, no interest charged above the cap since the start, installment 371.52) ended 2026-09-15, the day after the 2026-09-14 duty end; extension 2026-03-30 (more than 12 months after the first: spacing allowance one installment; Georgia charge 20.00); June and July 2026 installments unpaid at the loss (oldest 54 days); late charges 2026-07-09 / 08-08 / 09-08 / 10-09 at Georgia's 4.0 percent with the first-delinquency reductions of 50 and 25 percent on the first two (the 09-08 and 10-09 charges fall on installments due after the loss and stay out of the fee part); service contract cancelled for the theft (processed 2026-09-10) and refunded 287.59 on 2026-09-15, inside its 30-day period; frozen 2026-10-19 (113 days past due, below charge-off). Decoys: installments due after the loss; the older EDI proof; the day-prorated service-contract price; the first-payment-day installment count.

8. Factor cards and sensitivities: gap_ext_plus_starting_balance: expected 14142.25, all-baseline 12808.42, per factor bp_first_period=13804.3, bp_added_days=13844.05, bp_due_change_count=13796.04, bp_capped_rate_adjustment=13801.38 | gap_ext_plus_worksheet_benefit: expected 1027.96, all-baseline 0.0, per factor eu_past_due_count=656.44, eu_past_due_installment=823.36, eu_deferral_count=656.44, eu_deferral_installment=823.36, eu_placed_premium_basis=931.34, eu_addon_basis=592.96.

9. Persona. Kwame Adeyemi; volunteers the theft, insurer, report date and goal; gives phone/DOB/ZIP when asked; answers settlement, salvage, payment and service questions consistently with the records (active duty 2025-11-03 to 2026-09-14, the customer record's dates); accepts the benefit with the handed tool using exactly the figures given; ends when the benefit is on the claim. No ask beyond the goal, no hint, no figure steering.

10. Standard solution. Locate, verify, read addendum, claim, contract, ledger, servicing record, signed requests, tracking record and activity, service contract and activity; record the starting balance (14,142.25); hand the borrower the benefit acceptance tool (1,027.96).

11. Verification: recomputed with check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time world; gates in worklog.md.

12. Draft recomputation from the visible context: starting balance from the opening principal (amount financed plus 17 first-period days and 15 added days of interest) over 31 installments plus the two-stage cap adjustment = 14,142.25; Plus excluded total 371.52 + 18.58 + 371.52 + 165.08 + 287.59 + (750.00 - 500.00) = 1,464.29; benefit = 14,142.25 - 0.00 - 1,464.29 - 11,650.00 = 1,027.96. Agrees with gold.
user_scenario:
You are Kwame Adeyemi, 35, a staff sergeant in the Georgia Army National Guard who got home to Savannah in mid-September after a deployment. While you were gone, your 2020 Chevrolet Colorado was stolen from the storage lot where you had left it; your family reported it to the police on August 21 and it has never been found. Your insurer, Peach State Casualty Company, has paid out on it, and you reported the GAP waiver claim to Harborline Acceptance Corporation on October 6. Now you want to know where you stand: you want Harborline to work out what the GAP waiver will pay on your claim, so you can accept it and know what is left. You are fine with the representative working the figures out, and you will handle anything on your end if they tell you it is yours to do, including accepting the figure on the claim yourself. You are calm, organized and a little formal, and you have no idea how those amounts are worked out.

Only when asked do you give your details: the phone number on file is 9125550193, your date of birth is 1991-02-14 and your ZIP code is 31405; your email, if they want it, is kwame.adeyemi.sav@gmail.com. If they ask about the insurance settlement, the Peach State Casualty letter shows an actual cash value of $12,400.00 and a deductible of $750.00. If they ask whether there is any salvage or a deduction for old damage, you tell them the truck was never found, so there is no salvage, and the letter takes nothing off for prior damage. If they ask about your payments, you explain that the June and July payments did not go through while you were deployed and you have not paid since the truck was stolen. If they ask about your military service, you were on active duty from November 3, 2025 to September 14, 2026.

If the representative says a step is yours to do and gives you a tool for it, you use it at once with exactly the figures and reference they give you and read back what it confirms. You do not propose amounts, steps or rules yourself and you do not dispute a figure; if something sounds off you just ask them to check it against your records. Once the GAP benefit is on your claim, you thank them and hang up.
